P.text: A user signs and broadcasts a swap transaction through Ekubo's EVM Router, which forwards swaps to CORE.swap without reading a deadline or timestamp; SwapParameters contains no expiry value.
P.evidence_quote: Ekubo’s Router forwards swaps to CORE.swap without reading a deadline or timestamp. SwapParameters contains no expiry value either.

I.text: A swap transaction should have a deadline/expiry so it is rejected if mined after that timestamp, aligning with user intent and the Starknet implementation.
I.evidence_quote: Add a mandatory deadline parameter to every router entry point (single-hop, multihop, and multi-multihop). Reject swaps mined after that timestamp to align with users’ expectations and the Starknet implementation.

V.text: Once signed, a swap remains valid indefinitely; if it lingers in the mempool and the market moves, the router can still execute it later at the stale price, violating the user's intent.
V.evidence_quote: Once a user signs a swap transaction it remains valid indefinitely; if it lingers in the mempool and the market moves, the router can still execute it later at the stale price, violating the user’s intent.
